trigger.description: Persisted centrality rows (the latest valid memory-links graph snapshot) are missing or unusable, so the loadBearing section is honestly omitted and the rules ranking uses a neutral authority factor instead of recomputing graph metrics inline (ADR 0065 §1/§6 — the latency contract forbids inline graph computation).
setup_commands: ee remember 'Always run the verify script before pushing.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule --json

notes: Honest omission, never fabrication: a primer without a loadBearing section is correct for a workspace that has not refreshed graph snapshots. The repair refreshes persisted centrality; the next assembly then includes the section.
